android.desc:
Mini Piano Lite is a very responsive and realistic sounding piano for Android. It has been thoroughly optimized, resulting in a very enjoyable playing experience while keeping the install size to a minimum. 

Don't let the name fool you, this is a top digital piano instrument for in your pocket. It features a full keyboard with 88 zoomable and scrollable keys, with various display modes. The default instrument is a beautiful sampled piano, that sounds like the real deal, but there are also 128 other instruments included that cover a wide range of instrument types. 

The app has a great minimalist design (with darkmode support), that stays out of your way. You can play chords or melodies, find the right note when you are in a choir, and record your ideas or songs as MIDI files and export them (on a later moment if you want) to MP3, AAC or WAV. Or use the MIDI file in your favorite editor. 
Also included is a song mode with falling blocks, where you can learn to play new songs.

We took great care to minimise ad disruption by using only a single banner. No popups, no videos, no nothing. A simple banner to support our work. 

So, a small but very powerful piano app, loved by many many users. Why not give it a try? 

The app is optimized for phone, tablet and Chromebook. 

Let us know if you have a feature request or other feedback! You can email us at feedback@umito.nl
 
==Features== 
★ Fast, responsive and beautiful virtual piano 
★ 88 keys 
★ Great sampled piano sound 
★ 128 midi sounds 
★ Learn to play songs
★ Darkmode support with full dark keyboard
★ Optimized for tablet, phone and Chromebook 
★ Record songs as MIDI files
★ Export recordings to MP3, AAC or WAV 
★ Multitouch support for using all your fingers 
★ Easily zoom in and out to fit the keyboard to your screen
★ Label notes with their names and octaves
★ Use a metronome to keep a certain tempo
★ Transpose keyboard by note or tune it by Hz.
★ MIDI support (use it with a external USB or Bluetooth MIDI keyboard) 

Want a ad-free experience? Purchase Mini Piano Pro or KeyChord.

If you are looking for an educational version without ads that can be bulk licensed with a large discount for use in schools: feel free to email us at edu@umito.nl .
